```{r}
ss$celltype.new <- sobj$cell_type
table(ss$celltype.new)
DefaultAssay(ss) <- "RNA"
ss <- FindVariableFeatures(ss)
ss <- NormalizeData(ss)
ss <- ScaleData(ss)
ss <- RunPCA(ss, assay = "RNA")
ss <- RunUMAP(ss, dims = 1:30)
ss <- FindNeighbors(ss, dims = 1:30)
ss <- FindClusters(ss, resolution = c(.1,.5,1))

DimPlot(ss, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", reduction = "umap", label = T)
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "celltype", reduction = "umap", label = T)
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "celltype.new", reduction = "umap", label = T)
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD3E", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD3D", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD3G", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "PTPRC", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD7", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD5", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD4", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD8A", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "FOXP3", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "TRDC", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD8A", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CFH", reduction = "umap")


table(ss$celltype.new, ss$RNA_snn_res.0.1)
```


```{r}
final.clones <- readRDS(file = "final.clones.rds")

s161 <- ss
s161$final.clones <- ifelse(s161$RNA_snn_res.0.1 %in% c("0", "3"), "Malignant", "Non_malignant")
DimPlot(s161, group.by = "final.clones", reduction = "umap", label = T)

s162 <- ss
s162$final.clones <- ifelse(s162$RNA_snn_res.0.1 %in% c("0", "4"), "Malignant", "Non_malignant")
DimPlot(s162, group.by = "final.clones", reduction = "umap", label = T)

s163 <- ss
s163$final.clones <- "Non_malignant"
DimPlot(s163, group.by = "final.clones", reduction = "umap", label = T)

s164 <- ss
s164$final.clones <- ifelse(s164$RNA_snn_res.0.1 %in% c("0", "4"), "Malignant", "Non_malignant")
DimPlot(s164, group.by = "final.clones", reduction = "umap", label = T)


final.clones <- append(final.clones, s164$final.clones)

```





```{r}
Idents(ss) <- ss$RNA_snn_res.0.1
markers.all <- FindAllMarkers(ss, min.pct = .1)
markers.all$dif <- markers.all$pct.1 - markers.all$pct.2

markers.check <- FindMarkers(ss, ident.1 = c("4", "0"), ident.2 = "2", min.pct = 0.1)
markers.check$dif <- markers.check$pct.1 - markers.check$pct.2

ss2 <- subset(ss, RNA_snn_res.0.1 %in% c("0","3","6"))

DimPlot(ss2)
ss2 <- FindVariableFeatures(ss2)
ss2 <- NormalizeData(ss2)
ss2 <- ScaleData(ss2)
ss2 <- RunPCA(ss2, assay = "RNA")
ss2 <- RunUMAP(ss2, dims = 1:30)
ss2 <- FindNeighbors(ss2, dims = 1:30)
ss2 <- FindClusters(ss2, resolution = c(.1,.5,1))
DimPlot(ss2, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", reduction = "umap", label = T)

DimPlot(ss2, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.1", reduction = "umap", label = T)
DimPlot(ss2, group.by = "celltype", reduction = "umap", label = T)
DimPlot(ss2, group.by = "celltype.new", reduction = "umap", label = T)
table(ss2$celltype.new)
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD3E", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD3D", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD3G", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "PTPRC", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD7", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD5", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD4", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "CD8A", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "FOXP3", reduction = "umap")
FeaturePlot(ss2, features = "TRDC", reduction = "umap")

markers.t.check <- FindMarkers(ss2, ident.1 = "2", ident.2 = c("0", "1"), min.pct = 0.1)
markers.t.check$dif <- markers.t.check$pct.1 - markers.t.check$pct.2

ss2$celltype.study <- sobj$cell_type
```

```{r}
ss <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == "S147")
ss <- FindVariableFeatures(ss)
ss <- ScaleData(ss)
ss <- RunPCA(ss)
ss <- FindNeighbors(ss)
ss <- FindClusters(ss, resolution = c(.1,.3))
ss <- RunUMAP(ss, dims = 1:30)
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "cloneType")
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "xgboost")
DimPlot(ss, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1")

FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD7")

FeaturePlot(ss, features = "KIR3DL2")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD4")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "CD8A")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "TRBV10-2")
FeaturePlot(ss, features = "TRGV2")

additional.clones <- readRDS(file = "save/additional.clones.rds")
additional.clones <- c(additional.clones, ss$barcode[ss$RNA_snn_res.0.3 == "3"])
saveRDS(additional.clones, "save/additional.clones.rds")
```

```{r}
tmp <- FindNeighbors(tmp, reduction = "umap", dims = 1:2)
tmp <- FindClusters(tmp, resolution = .01)
DimPlot(tmp, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.01", label = T)

tmp <- FindNeighbors(tmp, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
tmp <- FindClusters(tmp, resolution = .5)
DimPlot(tmp, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", label = T)

markers <- FindMarkers(tmp, ident.1 = c("2"), ident.2 = c("0", "0", "1"))
markers$gene <- rownames(markers)
markers$dif <- markers$pct.1 - markers$pct.2

markers <- FindAllMarkers(tmp, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", min.pct = .1, logfc.threshold = .8)
markers$dif <- markers$pct.1 - markers$pct.2

FeaturePlot(tmp, features = "LINC02195")

extra.malig <- character()

keep <- CellSelector(DimPlot(tmp))
keep <- tmp$barcode[tmp$RNA_snn_res.0.01 %in% c("2")]

keep <- tmp$barcode[tmp$CTaa %in% c("CAVRNAGNMLTF_CASSSPQGYQPQHF")]

DimPlot(tmp, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.01", label = T, cells.highlight = keep)

extra.malig <- append(extra.malig, keep)
extra.malig.save <- extra.malig



extra.non.malig <- ss$barcode[ss$orig.ident %in% manual.ss]
extra.non.malig <- setdiff(extra.non.malig, extra.malig)
extra.non.malig.save <- extra.non.malig


saveRDS(extra.malig.save, "extra.malig.rds")
saveRDS(extra.non.malig.save, "extra.non.malig.rds")
```
